Name: Workstation Deck
Author: barnabys-drew
Description: Herdr agents that need you, terminal theme, YouTube Music in Chrome, window screenshots, and a services page.

Actions.Name: Claude needs you
Actions.Tooltip: Lights up when a Claude pane in Herdr is waiting or finished; press to jump to it

Actions.Name: Light / dark
Actions.Tooltip: Flip the terminal and Claude between light and dark

Actions.Name: Play / pause
Actions.Tooltip: Play or pause YouTube Music in Chrome

Actions.Name: Next / previous
Actions.Tooltip: Tap for the next track in YouTube Music, hold for the previous one

Actions.Name: Volume up
Actions.Tooltip: Raise Chrome's volume (hold to keep going)

Actions.Name: Volume down
Actions.Tooltip: Lower Chrome's volume (hold to keep going)

Actions.Name: Window screenshot
Actions.Tooltip: Screenshot the window in front to the clipboard and Pictures\Screenshots

Actions.Name: Services
Actions.Tooltip: Open a page linking every service published with tailscale serve, with up/down status
